PI.title: Raspberry Pi 5 thermal management
PI.supported_claim: Throttling begins at 80 C and increases at 85 C; neither temperature is a demonstrated terminal failure threshold.

JETSON.title: JetPack 6.2 power modes
JETSON.supported_claim: Orin Nano 8 GB original 7/15 W modes differ from Super 15/25 W and MAXN SUPER. No universal board thermal limit inferred.

TI.title: TI AM68A product specification
TI.supported_claim: AM68A lists four R5F cores, including device-management cores; available application cores require runtime allocation evidence.

AI64.title: BeagleBone AI-64
AI64.supported_claim: TDA4VM; 4 GB board RAM; six R5F cores on silicon. Custom 8 GB targets are separate configurations.

JACKAL.title: Clearpath Jackal manual
JACKAL.supported_claim: Maximum speed 2 m/s and maximum payload 20 kg. Braking and terrain coefficients still require measurement.

JACKAL-MASS.title: Clearpath platform comparison
JACKAL-MASS.supported_claim: Jackal platform mass 17 kg; configuration-dependent payload and accessories are additional.

PANDA.title: Franka control interface specifications
PANDA.supported_claim: Panda/FER torque vector [87,87,87,87,12,12,12] Nm. Do not reuse across FR3 without its own limits.

PANDA-STATE.title: libfranka RobotState
PANDA-STATE.supported_claim: Seven-joint measured and desired state fields are distinct; tau_J_d omits gravity, so raw torque subtraction needs convention reconciliation.

MSS.title: Marine Systems Simulator
MSS.supported_claim: Full vessel models use six degrees of freedom. The scalar drag lesson is a reduction, not an equivalent full vehicle model.

REMUS.title: Python Vehicle Simulator
REMUS.supported_claim: The illustrated REMUS model has 31.9 kg mass, 1.9 m length, and 0.19 m diameter; deployment variants require separate identity.

VALKYRIE.title: NASA R5
VALKYRIE.supported_claim: NASA lists 300 lb, 44 degrees of freedom, and 1.8 kWh battery energy. A capture-point model is a separate reduction.

IRIS.title: ArduPilot SITL with Gazebo
IRIS.supported_claim: Iris is a simulation model. Motor/thrust mappings require a pinned model and parameter set.

SITL.title: SITL simulation parameters
SITL.supported_claim: Failure and disturbance parameters alter the simulator; virtual EEPROM can retain changes between runs.

DART.title: DART spacecraft fact sheet
DART.supported_claim: ROSA and SMART Nav are spacecraft-specific subsystems. Their presence does not calibrate power-flex or optical-error proxies.

GTM.title: NASA GTM polynomial simulation
GTM.supported_claim: The cited GTM simulation is a 5.5-percent-scale model; full-scale aircraft properties cannot be silently substituted.

AERO.title: NASA dynamic pressure
AERO.supported_claim: q = rho v^2 / 2 defines dynamic pressure. Compressible flow still requires appropriate aerodynamic coefficients.

X43.title: X-43A Monte Carlo analysis
X43.supported_claim: Flight results exceeded some preflight Monte Carlo bounds; coefficients and uncertainty require case-specific flight evidence.

RF.title: ITU-R P.525-5
RF.supported_claim: Free-space attenuation is a propagation baseline; atmospheric and ionospheric effects require additional models.

JPL.title: JPL astrodynamic parameters
JPL.supported_claim: Earth GM = 398600.435507 km^3/s^2; convert by 1e9 to m^3/s^2. Vacuum c = 299792458 m/s.

BO.title: Blue Origin engines
BO.supported_claim: Current public BE-4 thrust is 2846 kN. Seven-engine baseline and older 550000 lbf configuration must not be conflated.

NG.title: New Glenn
NG.supported_claim: 7 BE-4 first-stage and 2 BE-3U second-stage engines. This lesson models only a declared scalar thrust balance.

CONTAINMENT.title: CNSC REGDOC-2.5.2 v2.1
CONTAINMENT.supported_claim: Containment pressure and energy management is design-specific. This reference supports scope, not numerical plant limits.
